name: Los Altos
authority: City of Los Altos and Mission Trail Waste Systems, its contracted hauler. The residential guide's carts are blue recycling, green organics, and gray garbage.

guide.title: Mission Trail Waste Systems: Los Altos residential service guide
guide.found_via: Linked from https://missiontrail.com/losaltos/ as Residential Service Guide

sections.recycling: Put RECYCLABLES in the Blue Cart
sections.compost: Put ORGANICS in the Green Cart
sections.landfill: Put GARBAGE in the Gray Cart

hazard.title: Mission Trail Waste Systems: Los Altos household hazardous waste

cardboard_box.reason: Flatten cardboard and paper boxes for the blue cart.

pizza_box_greasy.reason: Pizza boxes go in the green cart.
pizza_box_greasy.quote: takeout containers • pizza boxes • waxed paper

paper_mixed.reason: Junk mail and catalogs go in the blue cart.

paperboard_box.reason: Paper boxes go in the blue cart.

paper_bag.note: Clean paper bags are not listed. The green cart accepts paper bags only when they hold food scraps.

shredded_paper.reason: Put shredded paper in a paper bag, then the blue cart.
shredded_paper.quote: shredded paper - contained in a paper bag or box

paper_towel_napkin.reason: Food-soiled napkins and towels go in the green cart.

tissue.note: Facial tissue is not named. Food-soiled napkins go in the green cart; paper used for cleaning goes in the gray cart.

paper_cup.reason: Paper plates and cups go in the green cart.

paper_plate_used.reason: Paper plates and cups go in the green cart.

paper_takeout.reason: Paper takeout containers go in the green cart.

carton.reason: Dairy cartons go in the blue cart, not the green cart.

aseptic_carton.reason: Juice, soup, and soy-milk boxes go in the blue cart.
aseptic_carton.quote: aseptic boxes - juice, soup & soy milk

receipt.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

coffee_grounds_filter.reason: Coffee grounds and filters go in the green cart.

tea_bag.reason: Tea bags go in the green cart.

book.reason: Books up to 40 pounds go in the blue cart.

plastic_bottle.reason: Plastic bottles and jars go in the blue cart.

plastic_jug.reason: Plastic bottles and jars go in the blue cart.

plastic_tub.reason: Plastic tubs and trays go in the blue cart.

plastic_clamshell.reason: Plastic tubs and trays go in the blue cart.

plastic_cup.note: Not listed. Glass and ceramic cups go in the gray cart. Plastic cups are not named.

plastic_takeout.reason: Plastic tubs and trays go in the blue cart.

plastic_bag.reason: Stuff bags into one bag, tie it, then the blue cart.
plastic_bag.quote: plastic bags - Protect the environment by avoiding single-use bags.

bubble_wrap.reason: Plastic film and wrap go in the gray cart.
bubble_wrap.quote: plastic film & wrap • plastic plates & utensils

plastic_utensils.reason: Plastic plates and utensils go in the gray cart.

straw.reason: Plastic straws and stir sticks go in the gray cart.

snack_wrapper.reason: Plastic film and wrap go in the gray cart.
snack_wrapper.quote: plastic film & wrap • plastic plates & utensils

compostable_plastic.note: The green cart says no plastic. Compostable or PLA plastic is not named.

foam_food_container.reason: Foam and styrofoam go in the gray cart.
foam_food_container.quote: foam & styrofoam • hose - garden or rubber

foam_packaging.reason: Foam and styrofoam go in the gray cart.
foam_packaging.quote: foam & styrofoam • hose - garden or rubber

plastic_cap.note: Loose caps are not listed in the residential service guide.

coffee_pod.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

drink_pouch.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

toothpaste_tube.reason: Toothpaste tubes go in the gray cart.
toothpaste_tube.quote: rubber bands • toothpaste tubes • toys - that cannot be donated

toothbrush.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

plastic_toy.reason: Toys that cannot be donated go in the gray cart.

aluminum_can.reason: Cans and pans go in the blue cart.

food_can.reason: Cans and pans go in the blue cart.

aluminum_foil.note: Not listed in the residential service guide. The what-goes-where page names foil but its extracted text does not keep each item's color.

aluminum_tray.reason: Cans and pans go in the blue cart.

aerosol_can.reason: Empty aerosol cans go in the blue cart.

glass_bottle.reason: Glass bottles and jars go in the blue cart.

glass_jar.reason: Glass bottles and jars go in the blue cart.

broken_glass.note: Window glass goes in the gray cart. Broken bottles and jars are not named.

drinking_glass.reason: Dishes, bowls, and cups go in the gray cart.

ceramic.reason: Ceramics go in the gray cart.

food_scraps.reason: Food scraps, including peels and rinds, go in the green cart.
food_scraps.quote: fruits & vegetables - including peels, pits & rinds

food_in_container.reason: Scrape the food into the green cart first, then scan the empty container.
food_in_container.quote: fruits & vegetables - including peels, pits & rinds

bones.reason: Meat and bones go in the green cart.
bones.quote: coffee grounds & tea leaves • meat & bones

yard_trimmings.reason: Leaves, grass, and small branches go in the green cart.
yard_trimmings.quote: ivy & weeds • grass clippings • small branches

flowers.reason: Flowers and leaves go in the green cart.

cooking_oil.reason: Seal cooking oil and set it beside the cart, not in it.
cooking_oil.quote: Motor oil & filters, cooking oil and paint should be left next to your recycling cart but not in the gutter.

wooden_chopsticks.reason: Wooden chopsticks go in the green cart.

battery.reason: Bag batteries and set them on the blue cart, not in it.
battery.quote: Batteries, cell phones & PDAs, and fluorescent bulbs should be left on top of your recycling cart

phone_electronics.reason: Bag phones on the blue cart; take other electronics to e-waste.
phone_electronics.quote: Batteries, cell phones & PDAs, and fluorescent bulbs should be left on top of your recycling cart

also.quote: Computers, printers, televisions, fax machines, VCRs, stereo components, video game players, and other forms of e-waste

cords_cables.note: Not listed in the residential service guide or the hazardous-waste page.

bulb_fluorescent.reason: Bag fluorescent bulbs and set them on the blue cart, not in it.
bulb_fluorescent.quote: Batteries, cell phones & PDAs, and fluorescent bulbs should be left on top of your recycling cart

bulb_led.reason: Light bulbs other than fluorescent go in the gray cart.

bulb_incandescent.reason: Light bulbs other than fluorescent go in the gray cart.

paint.reason: Set water-based paint beside the cart; oil-based goes to PaintCare.
paint.quote: Motor oil & filters, cooking oil and paint should be left next to your recycling cart but not in the gutter.

also.quote: Find a PaintCare drop-off site for the nearest drop-off location.

cleaning_product.note: Plastic bottles and jars go in the blue cart, and the county hazardous-waste list includes cleaning fluids. The guide does not say which one a cleaner bottle is.

medicine.reason: Medications cannot go in any cart.
medicine.quote: Medications are considered hazardous and cannot safely or legally be placed in any Mission Trail cart.

sharps.reason: Sharps cannot go in any cart.
sharps.quote: Where can I take sharps? Please visit Convenient Locations

propane_cylinder.reason: Propane tanks cannot go in any cart.

diaper.reason: Diapers go in the gray cart.

pet_waste.reason: Bag pet waste, then the gray cart.

kitty_litter.reason: Bag litter, then put it in the gray cart.

face_mask.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

disposable_gloves.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

textiles.reason: Clothing that cannot be donated goes in the gray cart.
textiles.quote: shoes, clothing & stuffed animals - that cannot be donated

shoes.reason: Shoes that cannot be donated go in the gray cart.
shoes.quote: shoes, clothing & stuffed animals - that cannot be donated

cigarette.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

wipes.note: Not listed. Food-soiled paper towels go in the green cart; wipes are not named.

garden_hose.reason: Garden and rubber hoses go in the gray cart.

egg_carton_paper.note: Not listed in the residential service guide.

egg_carton_foam.reason: Foam and styrofoam go in the gray cart.
egg_carton_foam.quote: foam & styrofoam • hose - garden or rubber

frozen_food_box.note: Waxed paper and boxes go in the green cart. A frozen-food box is not named.
